subject: Junior Project Coordinator application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Legeneering team,

I'm applying for the Junior Structural Project Coordinator role at Henderson advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, where I tracked procurement and materials, kept material records and progress reports, and coordinated engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth.

The procurement, material management and documentation side of the role is the work I did on site. I haven't worked in fabrication, heavy industry or oil and gas yet.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Legeneering provides fabrication, maintenance and project services for the brownfield oil and gas industry from its production facilities in Henderson, WA.
letter.subject: Application for Junior Structural Project Coordinator, Henderson
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Structural Project Coordinator role at your Henderson facility, advertised on SEEK. The role's focus on project documentation, procurement and material management matches the work I did on site.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues. I later spent two years in technical support, resolving 40 to 60 cases a day and keeping accurate case notes.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, and in February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, preparing and reviewing drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I use Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

I have not worked in fabrication, heavy industry, oil and gas, marine or Defence, and my site experience is under one year, so I would be learning your workshop and project systems from the start. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and am open to discussing relocation from Melton to Perth.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
